data.body:
Phase 1 RCA — CONFIRMED defect, before any repair.

Proven mechanism: the ordinary-write gate at `src/rebar/llm/enrich_drain.py:313-321` needs only a boolean, but calls `pending_enrichment()`. `src/rebar/llm/overlap/queue.py:194-205` eagerly enumerates every ticket directory and calls `reduce_ticket`; `reduce_ticket:158-165` then resolves the already-canonical directory and performs three independent `_latest` probes, each of which lists that directory (`queue.py:91-100,127-165`). Therefore the no-pending common path scales with the entire 4,371-ticket store rather than queue work.

Runtime proof: direct live probes returned zero pending but took 453.676, 467.151, 437.443, 479.934, and 504.079 ms. cProfile observed 4,371 `reduce_ticket`, 13,113 `_event_names`/per-ticket list calls, and 2,302 event reads; `posix.listdir` alone consumed 313 ms of a 488 ms run. A discriminating zero-event synthetic sweep (two warmups + five samples) produced N=0: 0.014 ms; N=500: 23.101 ms; N=2,000: 91.055 ms; N=4,371: 201.779 ms, with exactly N reduces, 3N event-name scans, and zero event reads. That linear result confirms total-ticket enumeration alone breaches 20 ms by 500 empty ticket dirs and rules out queue-history JSON, pending volume, config, or imports as the necessary cause.

Amplifier experiments: a behavior-equivalent one-directory-scan probe matched all 4,371 ticket states and the pending set exactly, reduced per-probe ticket-directory scans 13,113→4,371, and improved live mean 758.550→224.449 ms, still >20. An identity-resolution + top-level scandir probe likewise matched all 4,371 states/pending exactly and improved 480.801→309.684 ms, still >20. Thus triple listdir and redundant resolve/stat are real amplifiers, but neither is the sole cause. Runtime profiling and counter instrumentation observed the mechanism executing; no production instrumentation or edits remain.

Defect legitimacy: `defect`. The closed design story `leggy-heedless-mosquito` explicitly set `DRAIN_GATE_BUDGET_MS=20` and required the no-pending write-path gate to finish within it; `src/rebar/llm/config.py:147-151` still calls 20 ms the cheap gate-check budget, and `enrich_drain.py:316-321` reports the breach. Commit 9af88c3 removed a flaky wall-clock CI assertion, not the production contract. Prior ticket ea2a / commit 3701dcbe3b explicitly said its bounded-open repair left `listdir` dominance and this separate budget defect unresolved.

Parsimonious cause: `pending_enrichment` is an exact all-candidate query built on per-ticket directories, but `maybe_drain` uses it as a constant-budget boolean gate on every write; the query/data-access shape at `queue.py:194-205` is not bounded by queue size or a queue-specific index. No repair has begun. Next gate: prove a remediation can preserve eligibility, soak/claim/done semantics, and caller behavior; any change to when enrichment runs or consistency is an operator decision.
